items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: And I think I knew about four or five tunes. And Abby used to say... And they used to stagger for lunch in Perentich, man... He asked Tony Perentich, who's the guy playing the jazz, you see. And then Tony said, yeah, the carnet plays the drum.

ctx.x: But what about Snoozer? You were going to tell about how?

Well, yeah. While they were here, while Whiteman was here, Snoozer was in town. So Brownlee and I, we wanted Whiteman to hear Snoozer, you see. And I had known Whiteman from Tony Perentich, man. I was working at the halfway house with Abby and I was just learning how to play a cornet thing, you see. And I think I knew about four or five tunes. And Abby used to say, you never learn how to play a thing as long as you live. And I told him, I'll see the day when I was stuck like that, you know. And they used to…
Not that one, but some of the others.
